privileged_info_for_vlm: The Business Partner Group must have Search Key 'BotGarden' and Name 'Botanical Gardens'. The Business Partner must have Search Key 'CITY_BOTANICAL', Name 'City Botanical Garden', and must be assigned to the 'Botanical Gardens' group. The 'Customer' checkbox must be active for the new Business Partner.
